Chapter 6
Results and Discussion
6.1
Introduction
The Intelligent Research Assistant was successfully designed and implemented using
FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, SQLite, FAISS, Sentence Transformers, Ollama, and Retrieval-
Augmented Generation (RAG). The developed application provides secure authentica-
tion, intelligent document management, semantic search, and AI-powered question an-
swering with citation support.
The system was tested using multiple research documents in PDF, DOCX, and TXT
formats. Experimental evaluation demonstrated that the application performs efficiently
in document processing, embedding generation, semantic retrieval, and grounded response
generation.
6.2
User Authentication Result
The authentication module allows users to register and securely log into the application
using email and password.
Passwords are hashed using the bcrypt algorithm before storage. After successful
authentication, a JWT access token is generated for accessing protected resources.
